gloss: fierce match; heated contest; close game; exciting battle

definitions.gloss: fierce match; heated contest; close game; exciting battle
definitions.explanation: A competition in which both sides are evenly matched and give their all, creating an exciting and closely fought contest, typically used in sports contexts.

examples.japanese: {両|りょう}チームの{熱戦|ねっせん}が{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた。
examples.english: A fierce match unfolded between the two teams.

examples.japanese: {決勝|けっしょう}は{手|て}に{汗|あせ}{握|にぎ}る{熱戦|ねっせん}だった。
examples.english: The final was an edge-of-your-seat heated contest.

examples.japanese: オリンピックでは{各国|かっこく}の{選手|せんしゅ}たちが{熱戦|ねっせん}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げ、{会場|かいじょう}は{大|おお}いに{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Athletes from various countries fought fierce contests at the Olympics, and the venue was buzzing with excitement.

notes:
A compound of {熱|ねつ} (heat, passion) and {戦|せん} (battle, match), describing a contest that is exciting, closely fought, and full of passionate effort from both sides. Primarily used in sports and competitive contexts.

USAGE:
- Most commonly appears in sports reporting and commentary
- Implies both sides are evenly matched and giving their all
- {熱戦|ねっせん}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる is the most characteristic collocation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱戦|ねっせん}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる: to fight a fierce match
- {手|て}に{汗|あせ}{握|にぎ}る{熱戦|ねっせん}: a nail-biting contest
- {熱戦|ねっせん}の{末|すえ}: after a fierce battle
- {熱戦|ねっせん}が{展開|てんかい}される: a heated contest unfolds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {激戦|げきせん}: fierce battle — can be used for actual warfare as well as sports; emphasizes intensity
- {接戦|せっせん}: close game — emphasizes the narrow margin rather than the excitement
- {好{勝負|しょうぶ}: good match — similar meaning but focuses on the quality of competition
- {死闘|しとう}: fight to the death — much more dramatic and extreme
